        # replace this
        self.set_value("app", "requirements", "python3,shiboken6,PySide6,pyjnius")


        # Allow automatic Android rotation
        self.set_value(
            "app",
            "orientation",
            "portrait, landscape, landscape-reverse",
            raise_warning=False
        )
        self.set_value(
            "app",
            "android.manifest.orientation",
            "fullSensor",
            raise_warning=False
        )
        
        self.set_value(
            "app",
            "android.activity_class_name",
            "org.nexttask.nexttask.NextTaskActivity",
            raise_warning=False
        )

        self.set_value(
            "app",
            "android.add_src",
            "../android_src",
            raise_warning=False
        )

        self.update_config()
